methods_definition.baseline: new_object_labels, cat/dog at confidence threshold 0.5, per frame
methods_definition.majority: independent per-class binary vote over same-chunk window; positive when vote share > 0.5; exact ties remain unresolved
methods_definition.confidence_mean: per-class maximum raw detection confidence (>=0.4 collection; missing=0), arithmetic mean over same-chunk window; positive at >=0.5
methods_definition.confidence_weighted: same as confidence_mean but frame weights 1/(1+distance), using ordinal distance or seconds as applicable; positive at >=0.5
methods_definition.unresolved: if no class gets >=0.5, emit no cat/dog label; retain-original policy separately evaluated
methods_definition.video_prior: eligible-only per-video class-label counts; replace only a single-species disagreement with dominant class at cutoffs .7/.8/.9; never override co-label frames
